name: Yakumo (Shimane, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Yakumo village emblem in yellow: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised three-armed device.
history: Flag of the former village of Yakumo in Shimane Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-03-31. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 March 1954.

features.role: Yakumo village emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised three-armed device
